correctness.rationale: Exact generating-function solution gives L_m=m2^{-b}Q_a(b). The nested integer floors collapse to one floor with nonnegative R. Global error epsilon<=a+1 and a split into early and last O(log b) diagonals show R=O_{a,K}(log b/b) uniformly at the first-positive threshold scale. A sandwich proves mu asymptotics and the nonintegral staircase. All integer/fraction computations in verify.py and independent direct labeled-firing tests passed. Growing-a and integer-limit cases are not asserted.
